correctness.rationale: The exact newly admitted faces are one 2-simplex for each vertex outside the two fault shores and one 3-simplex per cross-pair of remaining fault-shore vertices. A basis of signed four-cycles contracts the exceptional bipartite pair piece integrally; the graph-of-pair-spaces cover and primitive graph fundamental cycles then give the full wedge and integral split maps. Fifteen complete finite mod-two checks corroborate, not replace, the all-size proof.
